aws.eks.auto.note: EKS Auto Mode management of one instance, per hour, on top of the EC2 price; row is the instance type

aws.eks.cluster_hour.note: Kubernetes version in standard support, per cluster-hour

aws.eks.extended_support_hour.note: Charged on top of the cluster-hour while the version is in extended support

aws.eks.provisioned.note: Provisioned Control Plane tier, per hour, on top of the cluster-hour; row is the tier (tier-xl is XL)
